description: Curated demo songs across every Music Studio engine. Loading any demo auto-switches the editor to the right engine.
credits: IntyBASIC demos: Space Intruders soundtrack by paisleyboxers — used with permission.
ECS Hex Choir: composed for this editor.
IMT demos: from the trk-distro-rev4 distribution (Arnauld Chevallier 2008 + James Pujals 2020).
ZMUS Nutcracker March: arrangement by Joe Zbiciak.

demos.title: Space Intruders — Title Theme
demos.blurb: 3-channel techno arpeggio (Em–G–D), tempo 6, clarinet X over Z bass pedal. Flagship paisleyboxers track and the most-played IntyBASIC demo.

demos.title: Grid Runner — Gears
demos.blurb: DnB gameplay loop with mid-song MUSIC GOSUB calls sharing drum-only bars across three gear variations. The cleanest demo of GOSUB subroutine playback.

demos.title: ECS Hex Choir
demos.blurb: 8-channel ECS showcase: 6-voice chord pad (C–Am–F–G) with stacked drum strips. Demonstrates the IntyBASIC 8-arg MUSIC syntax.

demos.title: IMT — Voyage
demos.blurb: Clean 6-channel IMT demo from the trk-distro v1.5 distribution. Good first listen for the format — sparse melody, clear pattern structure.

demos.title: IMT — Beat It (DZ-Jay remix)
demos.blurb: Michael Jackson's Beat It tracked & remixed in IMT by James Pujals. Real composition showing instrument envelopes, drum samples, and pattern reuse across ~3800 notes.

demos.title: ZMUS — Nutcracker March
demos.blurb: Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker March in Joe Zbiciak's microprogrammed format (~970 DECLEs). Phase 1 imports as an opaque container — Phase 2 will decode it for piano-roll + playback.
